acceptanceCriteria: `corvint affected` (or the focused local check list) includes GOOS=windows go vet for touched packages, matching the CI step.
A regression fixture where a test uses a helper from a unix-only file is flagged locally before push.
body: Recurring class: V1-1092 (dispatch prompt_fragments_test.go used unix-only testConfig) and again PR #1089 on 2026-10-18 (internal/tasks/store/lease_bounded_audit_test.go uses newResumeFixture, moving and rewriteReceiptKeepingStamps from a unix-constrained file), each found only by CI job "Windows vet including test files (AFP-V0-042)", which costs a CI round and blocks merge. Neither `corvint affected` plans nor the lane doc-gate list run cross-OS vet locally.
title: Lanes miss Windows-only vet failures until CI: add GOOS=windows vet to the focused/affected local check
